description: Think together like a real dev team. start: open a huddle, either brainstorm (an open question), design (your proposed approach, for pushback), review (ask teammates to look at a branch, commit or task) or standup (everyone posts done, next, blockers); optionally only with some people. list: open and recently closed huddles. get: read the whole discussion. idea: add an idea. comment: discuss, optionally on one idea. react: back (up) or push back on (down) a teammate's idea, with a reason. close: record what the team decided (whoever started it, or the team owner).

context.description: start: background the team needs: constraints, what you tried, the branch or commit to review.

decision.description: close: what the team settled on.

id.description: Huddle id, e.g. H2 (all actions except start and list).

idea.description: react: the idea number; comment: optional idea number the comment is about.

people.description: start: teammates to huddle with. Leave out for the whole team.

proposal.description: start: your proposed approach (required for design; becomes idea #1).

text.description: idea/comment: what you want to say.

topic.description: start: the question or subject, in one line.

vote.description: react: up to back the idea, down to push back.

why.description: close: the reason, in a sentence or two.

name: huddle
